clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Herbalism is a training quest that directs skilled gatherers to seek specialized wilderness instruction in Elwynn Forest. Upon demonstrating proficiency in harvesting flora, herbalists are pointed toward Herbalist Pomeroy to learn the art of crafting campsite utilities. Completing this training unlocks the ability to create Incense Candles, botanical aids designed to bolster the focus and spirits of spellcasters resting in the field.

For wandering herbalists, harvesting herbs across the wilds of Azeroth serves purposes well beyond brewing basic restorative draughts or selling bundles of flowers to city merchants. As practitioners hone their gathering craft, opportunities arise to apply their floral knowledge toward wilderness survival. Field camps require more than just a roaring fire and dry bedroll; maintaining the endurance and mental acuity of a traveling party demands specialized comforts. Experienced foragers recognize that certain plants hold aromatic properties capable of invigorating weary minds. By directing promising herbalists toward established mentors, this task bridges simple gathering with practical fieldcraft, proving that a keen eye for nature's bounty can sustain an entire expedition far from civilization.

Aspiring herbalists seeking to expand their campsite craft are sent into the heart of Elwynn Forest to consult with Herbalist Pomeroy. Well-versed in the botanical varieties of the surrounding woodlands, Pomeroy understands how dried petals, aromatic stems, and natural resins can be blended into functional camp gear. Rather than using herbs solely for alchemy flasks, she instructs gatherers in the construction of an Incense Candle. When burned at a campsite, this fragrant creation soothes exhausted travelers and lifts the spirits of mana-reliant companions. Finding Pomeroy and proving one's competence with the sickle ensures that an herbalist becomes an indispensable asset to any adventuring party venturing into the untamed wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... And profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
